description: MCP server exposing OptiQra's website audit tools: SEO, GEO, AEO, and AI-generated fixes.
name: io.github.armin5872/optiqra-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the OptiQra instance to call. Defaults to https://optiqra.vercel.app.
environmentVariables.name: OPTIQRA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Default AI-provider API key used by the ai-fix/ai-insights/ai-test tools if the caller doesn't pass one.
environmentVariables.name: OPTIQRA_PROVIDER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.
environmentVariables.name: OPTIQRA_TIMEOUT_MS
